scope: Technical implementation for local concept. No deployment, no field Core Web Vitals measurement, no actual mail submission.

backup.assetMasterBaseline: 20 current masters match before/concept; approved Fibriki v10 matches approved-masters/fibriki-pack-v10.webp. Historical v9 backup remains unchanged.

ownedFiles.change: City feedback reset on every input/change; current city/product mailto; clipboard copy and manual readonly draft fallback; pending-copy revision guard. Existing mailto is opened only by explicit submit. Explicitly listens to an associated product selector outside the form; form= does not change event ancestry.

On-demand data-src/data-srcset/data-sizes hydration with decode before scene commit; last-request-wins navigation; sequential idle warm after load, disabled for hidden tabs, saveData and 2g; no autoplay.
Reproducible non-generative responsive WebP derivative pipeline; requires backup; writes atomically; verifies source stability and exact decoded alpha.
Integration manifest keyed by exact original source paths without query strings.
47 generated derivatives plus review-only QA sheets in _qa.
Portable builtins-only Node VM behavior tests; actual generated HTML defines controls, options and form/selector ancestry.

Revision guard prevents old asynchronous clipboard feedback/manual drafts after field, radio or format-link changes. Input and change both reset feedback; submit/copy clear prior feedback before validation.

integration.cityCopy: button type=button with data-city-copy; readonly hidden textarea data-city-draft with accessible label; existing .form-feedback role=status. Native city required validation remains.
integration.hero: First active scene keeps real src eagerly. Inactive images use placeholder normal src plus data-src, optional data-srcset and data-sizes. title text is supplied by parent in .product-title-live.
integration.manifest: manifest.assets[sourcePathWithoutQuery] has src (800 px), width, height, srcset. Packaging candidates are400/800; five illustrations add native-width candidates. Consumer supplies truthful sizes.
integration.qa: assets/responsive/_qa files are visual review aids, not runtime image sources.

assets.method: Pillow WebP method6; packaging q94, illustrations q90; premultiplied RGBA LANCZOS resize; no generative changes; originals preserved.

validation.sourceMatchesBackup: 20/20 historical baseline + 1/1 separately approved current v10 master pass
validation.metricCaveat: RGB MAE is an arithmetic foreground error, not a perceptual quality or legibility score. Alpha is compared against the corresponding resized RGBA reference, not against original dimensions.
validation.incrementalRebuild: 47 cached derivatives were decoded and remeasured; manifest SHA256 unchanged on rerun

visualReview.choice: q94 selected conservatively for all16 packshots after SOURCE/q90/q94 comparison of logo and small label text. q90 used for five illustrations. All16 400px package previews and all5 800px illustrations reviewed; contact mascot original/800 also reviewed separately. Current approved Fibriki v10 replaces v9 in the 16 current masters; v10 original,400,800 visually reviewed separately and the 400 gallery refreshed.
visualReview.observations: Package wording, shapes and drawings preserved in reviewed examples; no newly generated text. Original tiny outer flecks/crop boundaries were retained rather than retouched. No conspicuous new contour or label defects observed at review scales.

assets.historicalUnusedFiles: Earlier v9 derivatives remain on disk but are absent from current manifest and runtime references. They are not included in current 47-variant totals.

nodeSyntax.result: All three passed node --check (hero unchanged since its check)

city: known product query preset; unknown values are ignored
city: whitespace fails native validity and does not navigate
city: submit prepares current city/product and edit clears stale retry
city: external product select change clears old retry despite form association
city: clipboard success never navigates or sends; uses current request
city: unavailable/rejected clipboard exposes selected manual draft
city: product edit while clipboard is pending suppresses stale success or failure
partners: valid copy contains current form data and never navigates
partners: blank or whitespace required fields prevent copy
partners: manual draft is selected, then field change clears draft and stale retry
partners: field/radio/format-link edit cancels pending clipboard success and failure

hero: selection waits for artwork; responsive hints precede src
hero: rapid navigation commits only the latest scene
hero: rejected decode does not trap navigation or aria-busy
hero: End key focuses without scrolling and commits the last scene
hero: focus inside the old panel is moved out before it becomes inert

vmBehavior.method: Node builtins only, VM with minimal DOM, controlled image decode and clipboard promises. Parses actual generated HTML for relevant attributes/options/ancestry. No browser, network or real mail.

tests.assetManifest: All47 paths, dimensions, byte counts and hashes verified; 20 historical sources and current approved v10 match baselines; exact alpha per resized reference.
tests.generatorIntegration: Read-only AST execution of actual responsive_markup function, without running generator top-level: all21 current manifest masters replace src/srcset/width/height correctly.

acceptanceStillForParent: Integrate responsive attributes and accurate component sizes; verify currentSrc and requests at relevant viewports/DPR.
Browser-check copy success and unavailable-clipboard fallback after markup integration, editing city/product, and native validation. Do not send actual mail.
Browser-check delayed hero images, keyboard, rapid switching, reduced motion, and JS error console with final markup/CSS.
Measure real network/page performance separately; byte reductions do not establish LCP/INP/CLS improvement.

findings.fact: Product select lives outside city form; form attribute does not make input/change bubble to form. Added direct listeners for external select. Covered by current HTML topology tests.
Pending copy could restore stale status/draft after any field or format edit. Added revision guard; tests cover success/rejection and field/radio/format-link changes.
